agent_report.summary: Merged PR #17, which landed scheduled commitments with times and completed GOAL.md's Daily Planning section. CI was green on all three checks, all twelve acceptance criteria of Issue #16 were satisfied (verified against the diff, the new Playwright tests, and the published 360px/1280px screenshots), and the localStorage compatibility hazard was fixed in `getDay` as the Issue specified. Codex's external review found no issues. Work in flight then dropped to zero, so I created Issue #18 (weekly goals and week progress) and labelled it ready — it closes the Weekly Awareness section, the last two Definition-of-Done lines the week strip did not already cover. The project is not DONE: deadlines, overdue surfacing, carry-forward of unfinished work and day notes remain unbuilt.
